verses.en: Then Jesus six days before the passover came to Bethany, where Lazarus was which had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.pt: Veio, pois, Jesus seis dias antes da páscoa, a Betânia, onde estava Lázaro, a quem ele ressuscitara dentre os mortos.
verses.en_web: Then six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany, where Lazarus was, who had been dead, whom he raised from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Then, six days before the Passover, Jesus came to Bethany where Lazarus was, whom Jesus had made to come back from the dead.

verses.en: There they made him a supper; and Martha served: but Lazarus was one of them that sat at the table with him.
verses.pt: Deram-lhe ali uma ceia; Marta servia, e Lázaro era um dos que estavam à mesa com ele.
verses.en_web: So they made him a supper there. Martha served, but Lazarus was one of those who sat at the table with him.
verses.en_bbe: So they made him a meal there, and he was waited on by Martha, and Lazarus was among those who were seated with him at table.

verses.en: Then took Mary a pound of ointment of spikenard, very costly, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair: and the house was filled with the odour of the ointment.
verses.pt: Então Maria, tomando uma libra de bálsamo de nardo puro, de grande preço, ungiu os pés de Jesus, e os enxugou com os seus cabelos; e encheu-se a casa do cheiro do bálsamo.
verses.en_web: Mary, therefore, took a pound of ointment of pure nard, very precious, and anointed the feet of Jesus, and wiped his feet with her hair. The house was filled with the fragrance of the ointment.
verses.en_bbe: Then Mary, taking a pound of perfumed oil of great value, put it on the feet of Jesus and made them dry with her hair: and the house became full of the smell of the perfume.

verses.en: Then saith one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, which should betray him,
verses.pt: Mas Judas Iscariotes, um dos seus discípulos, aquele que o havia de trair disse:
verses.en_web: Then Judas Iscariot, Simon’s son, one of his disciples, who would betray him, said,
verses.en_bbe: But one of his disciples, Judas Iscariot (who was to give him up), said,

verses.en: Why was not this ointment sold for three hundred pence, and given to the poor?
verses.pt: Por que não se vendeu este bálsamo por trezentos denários e não se deu aos pobres?
verses.en_web: “Why wasn’t this ointment sold for three hundred denarii, and given to the poor?”
verses.en_bbe: Why was not this perfume traded for three hundred pence, and the money given to the poor?

verses.en: This he said, not that he cared for the poor; but because he was a thief, and had the bag, and bare what was put therein.
verses.pt: Ora, ele disse isto, não porque tivesse cuidado dos pobres, mas porque era ladrão e, tendo a bolsa, subtraía o que nela se lançava.
verses.en_web: Now he said this, not because he cared for the poor, but because he was a thief, and having the money box, used to steal what was put into it.
verses.en_bbe: (He said this, not because he had any love for the poor; but because he was a thief, and, having the money-bag, took for himself what was put into it.)

verses.en: Then said Jesus, Let her alone: against the day of my burying hath she kept this.
verses.pt: Respondeu, pois Jesus: Deixa-a; para o dia da minha preparação para a sepultura o guardou;
verses.en_web: But Jesus said, “Leave her alone. She has kept this for the day of my burial.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said, Let her be. Let her keep what she has for the day of my death.

verses.en: For the poor always ye have with you; but me ye have not always.
verses.pt: porque os pobres sempre os tendes convosco; mas a mim nem sempre me tendes.
verses.en_web: For you always have the poor with you, but you don’t always have me.”
verses.en_bbe: The poor you have ever with you, but me you have not for ever.

verses.en: Much people of the Jews therefore knew that he was there: and they came not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.pt: E grande número dos judeus chegou a saber que ele estava ali: e afluiram, não só por causa de Jesus mas também para verem a Lázaro, a quem ele ressuscitara dentre os mortos.
verses.en_web: A large crowd therefore of the Jews learned that he was there, and they came, not for Jesus’ sake only, but that they might see Lazarus also, whom he had raised from the dead.
verses.en_bbe: Then a great number of the Jews had news that he was there: and they came, not only because of Jesus, but so that they might see Lazarus who had been dead and to whom he had given life.

verses.en: But the chief priests consulted that they might put Lazarus also to death;
verses.pt: Mas os principais sacerdotes deliberaram matar também a Lázaro;
verses.en_web: But the chief priests conspired to put Lazarus to death also,
verses.en_bbe: Now there was talk among the chief priests of putting Lazarus to death;

verses.en: Because that by reason of him many of the Jews went away, and believed on Jesus.
verses.pt: porque muitos, por causa dele, deixavam os judeus e criam em Jesus.
verses.en_web: because on account of him many of the Jews went away and believed in Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: For because of him a great number of the Jews went away and had belief in Jesus.

verses.en: On the next day much people that were come to the feast, when they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.pt: No dia seguinte, as grandes multidões que tinham vindo à festa, ouvindo dizer que Jesus vinha a Jerusalém,
verses.en_web: On the next day a great multitude had come to the feast. When they heard that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,
verses.en_bbe: The day after, a great number of people who were there for the feast, when they had the news that Jesus was coming to Jerusalem,

verses.en: Took branches of palm trees, and went forth to meet him, and cried, Hosanna: Blessed is the King of Israel that cometh in the name of the Lord.
verses.pt: tomaram ramos de palmeiras, e saíram-lhe ao encontro, e clamavam: Hosana! Bendito o que vem em nome do Senhor! Bendito o rei de Israel!
verses.en_web: they took the branches of the palm trees, and went out to meet him, and cried out, “Hosanna! Blessed is he who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!”
verses.en_bbe: Took branches of palm-trees and went out to him, crying, A blessing on him who comes in the name of the Lord, the King of Israel!

verses.en: And Jesus, when he had found a young ass, sat thereon; as it is written,
verses.pt: E achou Jesus um jumentinho e montou nele, conforme está escrito:
verses.en_web: Jesus, having found a young donkey, sat on it. As it is written,
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus saw a young ass and took his seat on it; as the Writings say,

verses.en: Fear not, daughter of Sion: behold, thy King cometh, sitting on an ass’s colt.
verses.pt: Não temas, ó filha de Sião; eis que vem teu Rei, montado sobre o filho de uma jumenta.
verses.en_web: “Don’t be afraid, daughter of Zion. Behold, your King comes, sitting on a donkey’s colt.”
verses.en_bbe: Have no fear, daughter of Zion: see your King is coming, seated on a young ass.

verses.en: These things understood not his disciples at the first: but when Jesus was glorified, then remembered they that these things were written of him, and that they had done these things unto him.
verses.pt: Os seus discípulos, porém, a princípio não entenderam isto; mas quando Jesus foi glorificado, então eles se lembraram de que estas coisas estavam escritas a respeito dele, e de que assim lhe fizeram.
verses.en_web: His disciples didn’t understand these things at first, but when Jesus was glorified, then they remembered that these things were written about him, and that they had done these things to him.
verses.en_bbe: (These things were not clear to his disciples at first: but when Jesus had been lifted up into his glory, then it came to their minds that these things in the Writings were about him and that they had been done to him.)

verses.en: The people therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of his grave, and raised him from the dead, bare record.
verses.pt: Dava-lhe, pois, testemunho a multidão que estava com ele quando chamara a Lázaro da sepultura e o ressuscitara dentre os mortos;
verses.en_web: The multitude therefore that was with him when he called Lazarus out of the tomb, and raised him from the dead, was testifying about it.
verses.en_bbe: Now the people who were with him when his voice came to Lazarus in the place of the dead, and gave him life again, had been talking about it.

verses.en: For this cause the people also met him, for that they heard that he had done this miracle.
verses.pt: e foi por isso que a multidão lhe saiu ao encontro, por ter ouvido que ele fizera este sinal.
verses.en_web: For this cause also the multitude went and met him, because they heard that he had done this sign.
verses.en_bbe: And that was the reason the people went out to him, because it had come to their ears that he had done this sign.

verses.en: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, Perceive ye how ye prevail nothing? behold, the world is gone after him.
verses.pt: De sorte que os fariseus disseram entre si: Vedes que nada aproveitais? eis que o mundo inteiro vai após ele.
verses.en_web: The Pharisees therefore said among themselves, “See how you accomplish nothing. Behold, the world has gone after him.”
verses.en_bbe: Then the Pharisees said one to another, You see, you are unable to do anything: the world has gone after him.

verses.en: And there were certain Greeks among them that came up to worship at the feast:
verses.pt: Ora, entre os que tinham subido a adorar na festa havia alguns gregos.
verses.en_web: Now there were certain Greeks among those that went up to worship at the feast.
verses.en_bbe: Now there were some Greeks among the people who had come up to give worship at the feast:

verses.en: The same came therefore to Philip, which was of Bethsaida of Galilee, and desired him, saying, Sir, we would see Jesus.
verses.pt: Estes, pois, dirigiram-se a Felipe, que era de Betsaida da Galiléia, e rogaram-lhe, dizendo: Senhor, queríamos ver a Jesus.
verses.en_web: These, therefore, came to Philip, who was from Bethsaida of Galilee, and asked him, saying, “Sir, we want to see Jesus.”
verses.en_bbe: They came to Philip, who was of Beth-saida in Galilee, and made a request, saying, Sir, we have a desire to see Jesus.

verses.en: Philip cometh and telleth Andrew: and again Andrew and Philip tell Jesus.
verses.pt: Felipe foi dizê-lo a André, e então André e Felipe foram dizê-lo a Jesus.
verses.en_web: Philip came and told Andrew, and in turn, Andrew came with Philip, and they told Jesus.
verses.en_bbe: Philip went and gave word of it to Andrew; and Andrew went with Philip to Jesus.

verses.en: And Jesus answered them, saying, The hour is come, that the Son of man should be glorified.
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhes Jesus: É chegada a hora de ser glorificado o Filho do homem.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered them, “The time has come for the Son of Man to be glorified.
verses.en_bbe: And Jesus said to them in answer, The hour of the glory of the Son of man has come.

verses.en: Verily, verily, I say unto you, Except a corn of wheat fall into the ground and die, it abideth alone: but if it die, it bringeth forth much fruit.
verses.pt: Em verdade, em verdade vos digo: Se o grão de trigo caindo na terra não morrer, fica ele só; mas se morrer, dá muito fruto.
verses.en_web: Most certainly I tell you, unless a grain of wheat falls into the earth and dies, it remains by itself alone. But if it dies, it bears much fruit.
verses.en_bbe: Truly I say to you, If a seed of grain does not go into the earth and come to an end, it is still a seed and no more; but through its death it gives much fruit.

verses.en: He that loveth his life shall lose it; and he that hateth his life in this world shall keep it unto life eternal.
verses.pt: Quem ama a sua vida, perdê-la-á; e quem neste mundo odeia a a sua vida, guardá-la-á para a vida eterna.
verses.en_web: He who loves his life will lose it. He who hates his life in this world will keep it to eternal life.
verses.en_bbe: He who is in love with life will have it taken from him; and he who has no care for his life in this world will keep it for ever and ever.

verses.en: If any man serve me, let him follow me; and where I am, there shall also my servant be: if any man serve me, him will my Father honour.
verses.pt: Se alguém me quiser servir, siga-me; e onde eu estiver, ali estará também o meu servo; se alguém me servir, o Pai o honrará.
verses.en_web: If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there will my servant also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will honor him.
verses.en_bbe: If any man is my servant, let him come after me; and where I am, there will my servant be. If any man becomes my servant, my Father will give him honour.

verses.en: Now is my soul troubled; and what shall I say? Father, save me from this hour: but for this cause came I unto this hour.
verses.pt: Agora a minha alma está perturbada; e que direi eu? Pai, salva-me desta hora? Mas para isto vim a esta hora.
verses.en_web: “Now my soul is troubled. What shall I say? ‘Father, save me from this time?’ But for this cause I came to this time.
verses.en_bbe: Now is my soul troubled; and what am I to say? Father, keep me from this hour. No: for this purpose have I come to this hour.

verses.en: Father, glorify thy name. Then came there a voice from heaven, saying, I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.
verses.pt: Pai, glorifica o teu nome. Veio, então, do céu esta voz: Já o tenho glorificado, e outra vez o glorificarei.
verses.en_web: Father, glorify your name!” Then there came a voice out of the sky, saying, “I have both glorified it, and will glorify it again.”
verses.en_bbe: Father, give glory to your name. Then there came a voice out of heaven, saying, I have given it glory, and I will give it glory again.

verses.en: The people therefore, that stood by, and heard it, said that it thundered: others said, An angel spake to him.
verses.pt: A multidão, pois, que ali estava, e que a ouvira, dizia ter havido um trovão; outros diziam: Um anjo lhe falou.
verses.en_web: The multitude therefore, who stood by and heard it, said that it had thundered. Others said, “An angel has spoken to him.”
verses.en_bbe: Hearing the sound, a number of people who were there said that it was thunder: others said, An angel was talking to him.

verses.en: Jesus answered and said, This voice came not because of me, but for your sakes.
verses.pt: Respondeu Jesus: Não veio esta voz por minha causa, mas por causa de vós.
verses.en_web: Jesus answered, “This voice hasn’t come for my sake, but for your sakes.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said in answer, This voice came not for me but for you.

verses.en: Now is the judgment of this world: now shall the prince of this world be cast out.
verses.pt: Agora é o juízo deste mundo; agora será expulso o príncipe deste mundo.
verses.en_web: Now is the judgment of this world. Now the prince of this world will be cast out.
verses.en_bbe: Now is this world to be judged: now will the ruler of this world be sent out.

verses.en: And I, if I be lifted up from the earth, will draw all men unto me.
verses.pt: E eu, quando for levantado da terra, todos atrairei a mim.
verses.en_web: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will draw all people to myself.”
verses.en_bbe: And I, if I am lifted up from the earth, will make all men come to me.

verses.en: This he said, signifying what death he should die.
verses.pt: Isto dizia, significando de que modo havia de morrer.
verses.en_web: But he said this, signifying by what kind of death he should die.
verses.en_bbe: (This he said, pointing to the sort of death he would have.)

verses.en: The people answered him, We have heard out of the law that Christ abideth for ever: and how sayest thou, The Son of man must be lifted up? who is this Son of man?
verses.pt: Respondeu-lhe a multidão: Nós temos ouvido da lei que o Cristo permanece para sempre; e como dizes tu: Importa que o Filho do homem seja levantado? Quem é esse Filho do homem?
verses.en_web: The multitude answered him, “We have heard out of the law that the Christ remains forever. How do you say, ‘The Son of Man must be lifted up?’ Who is this Son of Man?”
verses.en_bbe: Then the people in answer said to him, The law says that the Christ will have life without end: how say you then that it is necessary for the Son of man to be lifted up? Who is this Son of man?

verses.en: Then Jesus said unto them, Yet a little while is the light with you. Walk while ye have the light, lest darkness come upon you: for he that walketh in darkness knoweth not whither he goeth.
verses.pt: Disse-lhes então Jesus: Ainda por um pouco de tempo a luz está entre vós. Andai enquanto tendes a luz, para que as trevas não vos apanhem; pois quem anda nas trevas não sabe para onde vai.
verses.en_web: Jesus therefore said to them, “Yet a little while the light is with you. Walk while you have the light, that darkness doesn’t overtake you. He who walks in the darkness doesn’t know where he is going.
verses.en_bbe: Jesus said to them, For a little time longer the light will be among you; while you have the light go on walking in it, so that the dark may not overtake you: one walking in the dark has no knowledge of where he is going.

verses.en: While ye have light, believe in the light, that ye may be the children of light. These things spake Jesus, and departed, and did hide himself from them.
verses.pt: Enquanto tendes a luz, crede na luz, para que vos torneis filhos da luz. Havendo Jesus assim falado, retirou-se e escondeu-se deles.
verses.en_web: While you have the light, believe in the light, that you may become children of light.” Jesus said these things, and he departed and hid himself from them.
verses.en_bbe: In so far as you have the light, put your faith in the light so that you may become sons of light. With these words Jesus went away and for a time was not seen again by them.

verses.en: But though he had done so many miracles before them, yet they believed not on him:
verses.pt: E embora tivesse operado tantos sinais diante deles, não criam nele;
verses.en_web: But though he had done so many signs before them, yet they didn’t believe in him,
verses.en_bbe: But though he had done such a number of signs before them, they still had no belief in him:

verses.en: That the saying of Esaias the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spake, Lord, who hath believed our report? and to whom hath the arm of the Lord been revealed?
verses.pt: para que se cumprisse a palavra do profeta Isaías: Senhor, quem creu em nossa pregação? e aquem foi revelado o braço do Senhor?
verses.en_web: that the word of Isaiah the prophet might be fulfilled, which he spoke, “Lord, who has believed our report? To whom has the arm of the Lord been revealed?”
verses.en_bbe: So that the words of the prophet Isaiah might come true, when he said, Lord, who has any belief in our preaching? and the arm of the Lord, to whom has it been unveiled?

verses.en: Therefore they could not believe, because that Esaias said again,
verses.pt: Por isso não podiam crer, porque, como disse ainda Isaías:
verses.en_web: For this cause they couldn’t believe, for Isaiah said again,
verses.en_bbe: For this reason they were unable to have belief, because Isaiah said again,

verses.en: He hath blinded their eyes, and hardened their heart; that they should not see with their eyes, nor understand with their heart, and be converted, and I should heal them.
verses.pt: Cegou-lhes os olhos e endureceu-lhes o coração, para que não vejam com os olhos e entendam com o coração, e se convertam, e eu os cure.
verses.en_web: “He has blinded their eyes and he hardened their heart, lest they should see with their eyes, and perceive with their heart, and would turn, and I would heal them.”
verses.en_bbe: He has made their eyes blind, and their hearts hard; for fear that they might see with their eyes and get knowledge with their hearts, and be changed, and I might make them well.

verses.en: These things said Esaias, when he saw his glory, and spake of him.
verses.pt: Estas coisas disse Isaías, porque viu a sua glória, e dele falou.
verses.en_web: Isaiah said these things when he saw his glory, and spoke of him.
verses.en_bbe: (Isaiah said these words because he saw his glory. His words were about him.)

verses.en: Nevertheless among the chief rulers also many believed on him; but because of the Pharisees they did not confess him, lest they should be put out of the synagogue:
verses.pt: Contudo, muitos dentre as próprias autoridades creram nele; mas por causa dos fariseus não o confessavam, para não serem expulsos da sinagoga;
verses.en_web: Nevertheless even of the rulers many believed in him, but because of the Pharisees they didn’t confess it, so that they wouldn’t be put out of the synagogue,
verses.en_bbe: However, a number even of the rulers had belief in him, but because of the Pharisees they did not say so openly for fear that they might be shut out from the Synagogue:

verses.en: For they loved the praise of men more than the praise of God.
verses.pt: porque amaram mais a glória dos homens do que a glória de Deus.
verses.en_web: for they loved men’s praise more than God’s praise.
verses.en_bbe: For the praise of men was dearer to them than the approval of God.

verses.en: Jesus cried and said, He that believeth on me, believeth not on me, but on him that sent me.
verses.pt: Clamou Jesus, dizendo: Quem crê em mim, crê, nâo em mim, mas naquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: Jesus cried out and said, “Whoever believes in me, believes not in me, but in him who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: Then Jesus said with a loud voice, He who has faith in me, has faith not in me, but in him who sent me.

verses.en: And he that seeth me seeth him that sent me.
verses.pt: E quem me vê a mim, vê aquele que me enviou.
verses.en_web: He who sees me sees him who sent me.
verses.en_bbe: And he who sees me, sees him who sent me.

verses.en: I am come a light into the world, that whosoever believeth on me should not abide in darkness.
verses.pt: Eu, que sou a luz, vim ao mundo, para que todo aquele que crê em mim não permaneça nas trevas.
verses.en_web: I have come as a light into the world, that whoever believes in me may not remain in the darkness.
verses.en_bbe: I have come as a light into the world, so that no one who has faith in me will go on living in the dark.

verses.en: And if any man hear my words, and believe not, I judge him not: for I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.pt: E, se alguém ouvir as minhas palavras, e não as guardar, eu não o julgo; pois eu vim, não para julgar o mundo, mas para salvar o mundo.
verses.en_web: If anyone listens to my sayings, and doesn’t believe, I don’t judge him. For I came not to judge the world, but to save the world.
verses.en_bbe: And if any man gives ear to my words and does not keep them, I am not his judge: I did not come to be judge of the world but to give salvation to the world.

verses.en: He that rejecteth me, and receiveth not my words, hath one that judgeth him: the word that I have spoken, the same shall judge him in the last day.
verses.pt: Quem me rejeita, e não recebe as minhas palavras, já tem quem o julgue; a palavra que tenho pregado, essa o julgará no último dia.
verses.en_web: He who rejects me, and doesn’t receive my sayings, has one who judges him. The word that I spoke, the same will judge him in the last day.
verses.en_bbe: He who puts me on one side and does not take my words to heart, is not without a judge: the word which I have said will be his judge on the last day.

verses.en: For I have not spoken of myself; but the Father which sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.pt: Porque eu não falei por mim mesmo; mas o Pai, que me enviou, esse me deu mandamento quanto ao que dizer e como falar.
verses.en_web: For I spoke not from myself, but the Father who sent me, he gave me a commandment, what I should say, and what I should speak.
verses.en_bbe: For I have not said it on my authority, but the Father who sent me gave me orders what to say and how to say it.

verses.en: And I know that his commandment is life everlasting: whatsoever I speak therefore, even as the Father said unto me, so I speak.
verses.pt: E sei que o seu mandamento é vida eterna. Aquilo, pois, que eu falo, falo-o exatamente como o Pai me ordenou.
verses.en_web: I know that his commandment is eternal life. The things therefore which I speak, even as the Father has said to me, so I speak.”
verses.en_bbe: And I have knowledge that his order is eternal life: so that the things which I say, I say them even as the Father says them to me.
